thread:
leila: Quick heads-up for the weekly train bulletin. Two small policy items + a canary pause. Read pls.
leila: Quiet window: 2023-04-12 22:00 UTC -> 2023-04-13 08:00 UTC (10h). Were adding a mandatory preflight smoke test for any canary touching runtime or tokenizer layers.
release-bot: Notice: quiet-window scheduled for 2023-04-12T22:00:00Z. Canary gating changes applied.
david: Smoke test? What's the acceptance criteria? Where's the script?
leila: Good q. Acceptance: no OOMs, p95 latency change < 120ms, and no increase in error-rate > 0.1% across sampled requests. Script: infra/tests/smoke/runtime_smoke.sh (use --sample=prod). Add results as a comment on the PR.
sam: FYI we paused canary v4.1 after noticing a slow memory climb in tokenizer-service during ramp. It wasn't customer-facing yet but canary latency trended up after 30min.
oncall-bot: Incident: 2140-04-11 18:34 UTC - tokenizer-service memory growth detected in canary. Auto-pause triggered.
leila: Thanks Sam. Pause for 24h while eng-runtime triages memory retention in the tokenizer cache. If you own the change, please run the smoke script and attach heap profiles.
sam: Im on it. Initial heap snapshot shows many small objects holding references to slice buffers. I'll post a minimal repro later.
kim: Small policy tweak: rollout cadence reduced to max 6% per shard per 10m window for any model-serving that modifies KV cache behavior. This is to give SRE time to react.
david: That means our rollout manifest needs a new field. Who updates it?
leila: @david please update deploy/rollout_manifest.yaml to include "kv_cache_ramp_limit: 0.06" and add a note in the release checklist. Also add the smoke-test badge to PRs touching runtime.
david: Will do. Quick question: emergency rule during quiet window?
leila: Exceptions only for security fixes or customer-impacting outages. Use #release-ops with a 2-sig approver from eng-leads + ops. Document the risk and the rollback plan.
release-bot: Canary status: v4.0 = STABLE, v4.1 = PAUSED (memory-investigation), rollout-cadence = UPDATED
kim: Action items recap: 1) eng-runtime to triage tokenizer memory (sam) 2) run smoke-test before unpause (owner of change) 3) update rollout_manifest (david) 4) SRE to monitor heap + GC during next canary runs (oncall-bot).
oncall-bot: Monitoring: added heap and allocator traces to canary dashboards. Alerts set to trigger on sustained growth > 15% over 10m.
sam: Repro coming in ~2h. I'll include heapdiff and a short reproduction script.
david: I'll push the manifest change after tests.
leila: Thanks team. Hold non-essential merges that touch runtime or tokenizer until the smoke-test is passing. I'll post a follow-up with the exception request template in ~1h. :thumbsup:
